scope: G2 selected-field adapter implementation and controlled A/P conversion; no COMSOL native invocation or trajectory execution by this agent.

independent_numerical_checks: XY affine electric vector evaluated off-node with negative x, kV/m to V/m scale and degC to K offset
RZ vector component/axis source values retained or changed only by explicit transform

Outside-domain partially finite values are tolerated; inside-domain missing values are rejected
Explicit finite-domain witness resolves old side duplicates; surviving ambiguous coordinates are rejected
Explicit domain ID column selects the correct owner at equal coordinates
limitations: Static node-associated single-domain XY/RZ P1 only
No native FE mesh convergence or trajectory parity certified by conversion
Per-export recovery/member gaps remain explicitly recorded; native source probes do not certify all off-node values
Axis transformation changes P1 values in incident cells and remains a declared model reduction
Time snapshots, cell/one-sided discontinuities, moving/remeshed geometry and domain unions require their own future qualified owner change
